title: Blue Mountain Beach 222 - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
Escape to this beautifully decorated 3BR/3BA condo in Blue Mountain Beach, offering rare privacy, resort-style amenities, and private beach access—all in a quiet, low-density building just off 30A.

✨ Highlights Guests Love 🏖️ Private Beach Access (uncrowded & peaceful) ☀️ FREE Beach Service (Mar 1–Oct 31) • 2 chairs + umbrella + table set up daily • Skip rentals & walk straight to the sand 🌴 Gulf-Front Pool + Hot Tub 🏋️ Fitness Center + Grills + Basketball Court 🚗 Gated, Covered Parking + Secure Building

🏡 The Space

🛏️ Sleeps 7 comfortably • King Suite (private wing + jacuzzi tub + balcony) • 2 Queen Bedrooms • 1 Twin Bed 📐 Spacious Layout • 1,625 sq ft + large 400 sq ft balcony • Open living/dining with plenty of seating • Split floor plan = ideal privacy for families or couples

🌅 Outdoor Living • Main balcony with dining + lounge seating • Private balcony off primary suite

🛋️ Comfort & Extras 📺 4 Smart TVs + sound bar 📶 Fast WiFi 🧺 Washer/Dryer (detergent included) 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen (stainless + granite) ❄️ Ceiling fans in every room

💡 Good to Know ✔️ Linens provided (bring beach towels) ✔️ Quiet, private setting between residential communities ✔️ Security onsite during peak season

🌟 Why Guests Love This Home ✔️ Rare private beach access + low-density building — just a 90-second walk to the sand ✔️ Complimentary beach setup (a guest favorite & big daily savings ☀️) ✔️ Spacious, open layout ideal for families or couples ✔️ Prime 30A location with a peaceful, uncrowded feel
